brief.headline: Cut laminate price by 77% to match market fair rate of ₹250/kg — we're paying ₹1067.36/kg vs. market ask of ₹205–305/kg.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250/kg on laminate (SKU: LAMINATE), down from ₹1067.36/kg
priceAsk.basis: We pay ₹1067.36/kg, a 326.9% premium over the ₹250/kg that Silk Polypack charges us. Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), rated MARKET-FAIR at top of fair band. Import reference for BOPET film substrate is 171.60 ₹/kg, so our current price includes a huge built-in margin.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 days after receipt — already reasonable terms

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki publishes no financials, so we can't measure their health or cash tightness directly. Our ₹76850 annual spend is tiny — we're a marginal customer to them, giving us little revenue leverage. That said, the 326.9% gap between our price and what we pay Silk Polypack, plus the market asking price of ₹205–305/kg, tells us their quote is far out of line. Push hard on price by showing the market data and lining up UFLEX or Constantia Parikh as credible second sources — the threat of losing even a small order may prompt a realistic re-quote.

evidence.point: Silk Polypack (our best vendor) charges ₹250/kg for the same material
Our price is 326.9% higher than Silk Polypack
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg, rated MARKET-FAIR
BOPET film substrate import reference is 171.60 ₹/kg
Cutting the price to market rate saves us ₹58850 annually

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant — both film substrate AND conversion; can second-source laminate at scale

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter — pharma blister/sachet laminates; strong second-source (revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health D 31/100)

risks: Our ₹76850 annual spend is tiny to Huhtamaki — we have little revenue leverage, so they may refuse to move much on price
Huhtamaki's financials aren't public — we can't gauge if they're cash-tight or stable, so calibrate pressure carefully
The 326.9% gap is extreme — if they won't come down significantly, qualify UFLEX or Constantia Parikh quickly to avoid being locked in
Payment terms are already 30 days — no room to trade faster payment for a price cut
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're paying you ₹1067 per kilo for laminate while the market asking price is ₹205–305 and our best vendor charges ₹250 — help us understand the gap and get to a market-fair number.
